en.confirm.purge: Emptying the bin really deletes these records: the local ones and the matching objects in the cloud (record JSON/text, plus any attachment only they referenced). It cannot be undone. The original bytes in dshu2019s attachment store stay. Continue?
en.confirm.untag: Remove the tag u201C{tag}u201D from {count} record(s)? The records themselves stay.

en.detail.foreignBody: the panel does not embed other peopleu2019s players, so open it in the browser u2014 that is where the big screen is.
en.detail.name: Name

en.detail.nameTitle: The name the list, the cards and the conversation show; empty falls back to the file name or the note
en.detail.notePlaceholder: Note, e.g. ID photo / video to watch / this key is for staging (when there is no name, it becomes the rowu2019s name)
en.detail.noteTitle: What you write always outranks what the model guessed
en.detail.sealedNote: This body is ciphertext and cannot be read. Unlock it under Settings u2192 Credential encryption; if the parameters that open it have not arrived yet (the record came over sync), hit Sync once.

en.dock.editHint: Changing the category, the note or deleting all happen in the u201C{panel}u201D panel on the left.
en.dock.gone: Could not read this record; it may have been deleted.

en.manual.1.chat.label: In the conversation
en.manual.1.chat.tail: , attach images straight onto the composer; nothing is sent to the model.
en.manual.1.panel.body: Paste text or a link, drop in images or files, or press u201CChoose a fileu2026u201D and then u201CSave to vaultu201D (Ctrl+Enter works too).
en.manual.1.panel.label: Panel
en.manual.1.repeat.body: Saving the same thing twice does not add a row u2014 it joins the record it already has, and pulls it out of the bin if that is where it was.
en.manual.1.repeat.label: Repeats
en.manual.1.title: 1. Getting things in
en.manual.2.detail.body: The right-hand pane edits the name, category, note and tags, and can flag, delete or restore.
en.manual.2.detail.label: Record
en.manual.2.filter.body: u201CAll / To read / Binu201D on the left exclude categories and tags; u201CTo readu201D is your own flag, and new records carry none.
en.manual.2.filter.label: Filters
en.manual.2.list.body: Two densities (grid / compact) switch with a click and are remembered; the search box covers title, text, link and note.
en.manual.2.list.label: List
en.manual.2.title: 2. Browsing and editing
en.manual.3.icon.label: Glyphs
en.manual.3.icon.tail: each have their own glyph; a credential is a key, recognisable at a glance.
en.manual.3.order.body: the name you typed u2192 the fetched page title u2192 the link/text/file name u2192 the note (the last resort).
en.manual.3.order.label: Order
en.manual.3.title: 3. Where a rowu2019s name comes from
en.manual.3.who.label: Who judged it
en.manual.3.who.lead: the badge beside the category comes in three kinds:
en.manual.3.who.tail: (a category you chose is never overwritten by rules or the model).
en.manual.4.never.body: the list shows only the name you gave it; a conversation gets a one-line refusal; classification requests are redacted first.
en.manual.4.never.label: Never shown
en.manual.4.password.body: Settings u2192 Credential encryption. Once set, credential bodies are ciphertext on disk; without one they are refused (better not to store it than to store it in the clear).
en.manual.4.password.label: Set a master password first
en.manual.4.title: 4. Credentials
en.manual.4.unlock.body: neither the password nor its key is written down, so a restart needs one unlock in the same place; a forgotten password cannot be recovered.
en.manual.4.unlock.label: Every restart locks it
en.manual.5.auto.body: a few seconds after a capture or an edit a push goes out (debounced u2014 five quick saves push once).
en.manual.5.auto.label: Automatic
en.manual.5.cloud.body: Records and attachments both travel; only credential bodies are ciphertext u2014 text, links, notes and attachments are plain text, so the bucket needs access control.
en.manual.5.cloud.label: What goes up
en.manual.5.delete.body: u201CDeleteu201D in the panel only moves a record to the bin (other devices learn it is gone instead of pushing it back); emptying the bin is the real delete, and the cloud copy goes with it.
en.manual.5.delete.label: Deleting
en.manual.5.manual.body: u201CRefreshu201D in the top right is a full sync: push local changes, pull the others, then re-read the list.
en.manual.5.manual.label: Manual
en.manual.5.merge.body: Incoming records merge by id + timestamp: the newer write wins, no conflict copies.
en.manual.5.merge.label: Merging
en.manual.5.title: 5. Sync (this machine u2194 the cloud)
en.manual.5.twoMachines.body: Both machines need the same u300Cu76EEu5F55u300D (blank, / and inbox all mean the same directory). While they differ nothing crosses over by default: the refresh says u201CN records live in another sync directoryu201D, and either matching them or ticking u201CMerge other sync directories toou201D brings them in.
en.manual.5.twoMachines.label: Two machines
en.manual.6.get.body: then say u201Copen number 3u201D and it comes back: text (up to 1000 characters), link, note, tags and attachment facts.
en.manual.6.get.label: Fetch
en.manual.6.query.body: just ask: u201Cwhich links in my inbox havenu2019t I read yet?u201D The assistant searches the vault, lists at most 10, and tells you how many are left. u6536u4EF6u7BB1 / u4ED3u5E93 / inbox all mean the same shelf.
en.manual.6.query.label: Ask
en.manual.6.refuse.body: a credential never comes back in clear text, and an image comes back as a marker the UI draws locally. To have the assistant look at a picture (say, u201Cwhat is this code?u201D), ask it to u2014 that one call sends that one image.
en.manual.6.refuse.label: Two hard refusals
en.manual.6.title: 6. Getting things back in the conversation
en.manual.6.tools.body: this session was not started with the inbox plugin. Open a new session and ask again u2014 the panel working and the assistant seeing the tools are two different things.
en.manual.6.tools.label: The assistant says it does not know this vault
en.manual.7.sync.body: press u201CTestu201D in Settings: it says whether the channel works and which signature shape is accepted. An authentication refusal usually means the client identity does not match the application the AccessKey is bound to.
en.manual.7.sync.label: Sync looks wrong
en.manual.7.title: 7. When something looks wrong
en.manual.7.title.body: normal: some sites (WeChat among them) serve non-browser requests an empty shell page with no title. Open the record and name it yourself.
en.manual.7.title.label: A link has no name
en.manual.7.zero.body: a placeholder the cloud drive made itself, not something the plugin wrote u2014 ignore it.
en.manual.7.zero.label: A 0-byte directory in the cloud
en.manual.title: Manual
en.modes.label: List density
en.notice.captureEmpty: Nothing to save yet: paste some text or a link, or drop an image in
en.notice.listModeUnsaved: The list layout was not remembered: {reason}
en.notice.listUnreadable: Could not read the list: the host answered with something we cannot read

en.settings.adoptForeignHint: (brings back records a machine left under an older directory; off by default)
en.settings.clientIdS3: empty means dsh-inbox; some gateways identify callers by it u2014 use the application this AccessKey is bound to
en.settings.clientIdWebdav: empty means dsh-inbox; some gateways identify callers by it u2014 use the application this WebDAV account is bound to
en.settings.directoryPlaceholder: inbox (the default u2014 blank or / means the same)
en.settings.dirS3.lead: the directory is also the key prefix for S3 (default
en.settings.ingestOnly: One way only: other devices drop files there, this machine pulls them in. The password lives in dshu2019s credential store, not in the config.
en.settings.lockedBody: Enter the master password to unlock; the key is never written down, so every restart asks again.
en.settings.lockedNote: Locked: credential bodies stay unreadable until you unlock again
en.settings.noServiceBody: this composition has no settings service, so the address cannot be changed u2014 you are most likely running the headless shape.
en.settings.otherPassword: {count} more cannot be opened: they were sealed with another master password u2014 enter that one.
en.settings.otherPasswordNoParams: {count} more cannot be opened: they came from another machine u2014 hit Sync once to bring its parameters over.
en.settings.passwordJustSet: Master password set u2014 credentials are now encrypted at rest
en.settings.passwordSealed: Master password set, and {count} old records went from plain text to ciphertext
en.settings.sealedNoParams: {count} sealed records, unlocking parameters not here yet
en.settings.sealedNoParamsBody: Hit Sync once to pull them over, then enter the master password from the machine that sealed them.
en.settings.secretsBody: Credential bodies are stored encrypted. The key is never written down: every restart locks the vault again, and a forgotten password cannot be recovered.
en.settings.unlockedBody: Credentials can be read and written until this process restarts.
en.source.model.hint: the rules could not decide, so the model did; what you say always wins and can be changed any time
en.source.rule.hint: the local rules judged this from the shape of the link, text or image u2014 no network was used
en.source.user.hint: the category you chose yourself u2014 neither the rules nor the model will overwrite it
